name: AiFax
summary: Stop uploading faxes by hand. AiFax files them to the Hint chart, within what Hint allows.
overview:
Your staff downloads every fax, reads it, finds the patient and uploads it into Hint by hand. Referrals, labs and prior auths sit until someone gets to them.

AiFax does that work for you. Every incoming fax is summarized by AI in about a minute, matched to the right patient by name and date of birth, and filed into that patient's chart in Hint, within what Hint allows. Unsure matches go to your staff for review, never to a guess.

Keep your fax number either way: switch your line to AiFax, or keep your current fax provider and forward your faxes to AiFax. HIPAA compliant, with a signed BAA.
